title: Configuration program well-formedness
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,T$ be natural numbers. Suppose every source in the input list $\ell$ is either an input bit with index less than $n$, a Boolean constant, or a bit of a block with block index less than $0$ and bit index less than the configuration width. Then every source used by an instruction at index $i$ in the configuration program is an input bit of index less than $n$, a constant, or a bit of a block with index less than $i$ and bit index less than the configuration width; moreover, every instruction in the program has source-list length equal to the configuration arity.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
Every source in $\ell$ is valid for input width $n$, configuration width, and instruction index $0$
